entities.summary: Maria Luz Gabás Ariño is a Spanish novelist and politician, best known for her novels Palmeras en la nieve (2012), Regreso a tu play (2014), Como fuego en el hielo (2017), El latido de la tierra (2019) and Lejos de Luisiana (2022), Premio Planeta winner in the same year.
